name: GenAI-Bench
intro: GenAI-Bench 是从 GenAI-Arena 社区投票中清洗得到的多模态偏好基准，用于衡量 MLLM 裁判能否在图像生成、图像编辑和视频生成任务上复现人类四分类偏好。它与另一个含1,600条组合式提示词的同名文生视觉基准不同。
build_method: 匿名社区投票, NSFW清洗, 专家抽样复核
modality: 图像, 视频, 文本
task_type: 多模态裁判, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 四分类偏好, 精确匹配, 社区投票
build_method_en: Anonymous Community Voting, NSFW Filtering, Expert Sample Review
eval_feature_en: Four-way Preference Labels, Exact Match, Community Votes
intro_en: GenAI-Bench is a multimodal preference benchmark cleaned from GenAI-Arena community votes. It measures whether MLLM judges reproduce human four-way preferences across image generation, image editing, and video generation. It is distinct from the separate 1,600-prompt compositional text-to-visual benchmark with the same name.
scale_en: 3,723 preference pairs (1,735 image generation; 919 editing; 1,069 video)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.04485 and the official TIGER-Lab/GenAI-Bench card. This entry is the GenAI-Arena preference benchmark, not the separate 1,600-prompt compositional GenAI-Bench. The Arena standardizes 35 open models across text-to-image, image editing, and text-to-video; mixes live user prompts with ImagenHub/VBench prompts and precomputed GenAI-Museum outputs; anonymously presents same-task pairs; and collects left-better, right-better, tie-good, or both-bad votes. An author audit of 350 votes leaves 303 valid and finds 93.07% clearly or vaguely reasonable. Llama Guard and technical filters yield 1,735 image-generation, 919 editing, and 1,069 video preference pairs, 3,723 total. An MLLM judge receives the prompt and output pair, must emit one of four exact labels, and is scored by exact agreement with the human vote for each task and on average. Arena Bradley–Terry Elo ranks generators, whereas GenAI-Bench accuracy evaluates judges.
